Name: id_hh
Format:
A character chain:
Household number - variant of study (a, o) - recruitment process (p, r) * id of simulation
[1-9]* - {a, o} - [a-z][1-50]
Comment:
p for pedcovid-like
r for random

Name: date_sympt
Format:
Number:
30 is assigned to the first symptoms/detection of the household, dates for other individuals are assigned relatively
1000 is assigned to individuals who are not infected

Name: infect_status
Format:
0: not infected
1: infected and symptomatic
2: infected and asymptomatic

Name: end_followup
Format:
Number:
Date is assigned relatively to symptoms/detection dates

Name: age
Format:
0: <6 years old
1: 6-11 years old
2: >11 years old

Name: protected
Comment: Protection is vaccination or past infection

Name: variant
Comment: These are optional, and always identical for all individuals of a simulation

Name: id_simu
Format: Number (when I launch multiple simulations at a time, they have an id)
